verdict.rationale: Whether source is available under an open license is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, since open-source alternatives exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Trello's own source being published or licensed openly. The Power-Up Skeleton and sample projects are developer starter code, not the product's source, and the open-source mention refers to a different product (WeKan).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
